messages:
amelia: Heads-up: BlueArc SI hit a telemetry handshake timeout during pre-prod validation for AcmeHealth private cluster. They called out `handshake timeout 30s` from the agent; customer is planning cutover Monday.

mattp: timeline?

amelia: Cutover Monday. SI asks for architecture review and guidance on mTLS, ports, and fallback routing before we send field eng.

raj: paste agent logs and image tag

amelia: log:
```
2026-06-01T18:02:12Z agent[1]: telemetry: handshake failed: timeout waiting for proto response
2026-06-01T18:02:15Z agent[1]: retrying (3/5)
```
image: redwood/si-agent:1.4.2

sara: @ops-bot can you confirm the cert bundle on that image? last rotation 2026-05-28

ops-bot: (automated) redwood/si-agent:1.4.2 contains cert bundle v20260528. No revocations detected. :white_check_mark:

raj: could be SNI mismatch or blocked port. Ask SI to run `nc -vz telemetry.acmehealth.internal 443` and traceroute from connector host

bluearc-si: ran checks: `nc: connect to telemetry.acmehealth.internal port 443 (tcp) failed: Connection timed out`. Also intermittent 502 from our proxy when TLS session resumed.

mattp: sounds like a network path issue. Amelia, can you get pcap and traceroute? I'll loop in net team. @raj pls prepare mTLS config suggestion.

raj: draft snippet:
```yaml
proxy:
  upstream: telemetry.acmehealth.internal:443
  tls_server_name: telemetry.acmehealth.internal
  session_resumption: true
  ca_bundle: /etc/si/ca.pem
```

amelia: scheduling 30m sync with SI + net team 10:30 PT. I'll include runbook and checklist.

sara: prepping customer comms and risk note. :thumbsup:

bluearc-si: we'll run the traceroute and post outputs before sync.

mattp: if net team confirms port block, advise SI to open 443 from connector IP range and we can proceed.

amelia: thanks all. adding notes to the ticket and will escalate to field eng if network fixes don't resolve. End thread.
